evaluation_components.notes: Lab-compre (15%): 7-8 days; Theory (30%): 3 hours, Closed/open book

attendance_policy: Each student is expected to attend all classes and participate in all evaluation components.
makeup_policy: For a foreseen absence, a make-up request should be made to the instructor-in-charge. Reasons for unanticipated absence that qualify one for make-up include medical or similar personal emergencies only. Makeup will be given only for the Mid-semester or comprehensive exam only.
